FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 181
Committee: Ports, Waterways, and Intermodal Transit Sponsor: Representative Craig Lipscomb
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 02/20/2024
House Bill 181 as introduced would create the 17-member Alabama Waters Task Force which
could increase the obligations of the respective appointing authorities by an estimated $164 per
member per meeting, for reimbursement of actual expenses associated with attending meetings.
This bill could also increase the administrative obligations of the Department of Conservation
and Natural Resources and the Alabama Department of Environmental Management to provide
the necessary staff and support for the task force.
